baselines.title: Fast, accurate, and differentiable neural-network surrogate for NRSur7dq4
baselines.method: JAX differentiable MLP surrogate with independent networks for decomposed waveform quantities and a differentiable waveform-to-likelihood pipeline
baselines.benchmark_caveat: These are paper-reported results against NRSur7dq4. They are not direct comparisons with Symtropy or a measured result on our hardware.

baselines.title: NRSur7dq4v2: multi-domain precessing surrogate with improved accuracy

parameter_domain.reference_domain: NRSur7dq4 parameter domain; confirm exact supported parameter range from the pinned model release

reported_changes: overlapping temporal subdomains provide separate inspiral and merger-ringdown error control
gwsurrogate precessing-surrogate package optimized by about fourfold

reported_performance.gwsurrogate_runtime_change: about 4x speedup; slightly faster than LALSimulation counterparts

baselines.benchmark_caveat: The 3-10x result concerns remnant mass/spin estimates from quasi-normal fits to the surrogate ringdown, not a universal waveform-mismatch reduction.

baselines.title: Autoencoder-based surrogate waveform model for quasicircular binary-black-hole mergers

reported_performance.template_bank_generation: millions of waveforms in under one second on modest computational resources

baselines.method: Autoencoder trained on NRHybSur3dq8 and fine-tuned using SXS simulations
baselines.benchmark_caveat: Recheck exact event domain, parameter coverage, and benchmark hardware from the paper before a direct comparison.

baselines.title: Eccentric binary black holes: a new framework for numerical-relativity waveform surrogates
baselines.method: Radial-phase inspiral decomposition plus a separate time-domain merger-ringdown surrogate
baselines.benchmark_caveat: Narrow nonspinning eccentric domain; not comparable to generic precessing models without matching the parameter slice.

recommended_luminous_differentiator.name: physics-qualified surrogate with an explicit applicability and uncertainty certificate
required_properties: separate inspiral, merger, and ringdown validation domains
cross-model ensemble disagreement as an active-learning signal
error-vs-latency and error-vs-memory profiles on declared hardware
stable versioning and evidence provenance through Mycelix
recommended_luminous_differentiator.success_metric: Lower time-to-posterior-accuracy and lower calibration error at equal or better coverage, on held-out simulations and injection sets; not raw waveform throughput alone.

spec_accuracy_reference.title: How accurate is Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC)? And what limits its accuracy?
reported_findings: targeted changes to resolution and parameter choices in distinct computational subdomains can reduce constraint violations and waveform differences
at sufficiently high resolution, floating-point limitations and disparate scales of fundamental variables become significant
spec_accuracy_reference.benchmark_implication: Record precision, nondimensionalization, variable scaling, resolution, and error-vs-cost curves; do not assume increasing resolution always improves accuracy.
